admin_settings.description: A workspace admin on Members, Billing and Settings (Configuration). All reads — the Billing page's checkout/portal buttons create Stripe sessions and are never part of a journey.

manager_review.description: A manager checking team analytics and saved lists.

platform_customers.description: Platform staff looking a customer up in the directory (/admin/billing/customers).

rep_daily.description: A rep working the queue: Inbox, the account list, one account, the signal feed, contacts.

rep_landing.description: The rep's landing page. Since 3c7adbe a rep may read /analytics/overview (scoped to their own work) because the dashboard is every rep's first request.

email_draft.description: Draft outreach for one account (the "messaging" agent, capability ai.email_draft).

find_contacts.description: Source the buying committee for one account (Exa search, Apify, Reacher verification).

lookalikes.description: Find companies similar to one account (Exa).

research_brief.description: Research brief for one account (the "research" agent, capability ai.research_brief). The agent also runs web search through the configured browser provider.

signal_ingest.description: Run every signal source for one account now (Firecrawl, web search, LLM scoring).

worker_health.description: Queue depth, dead letters and job outcomes from the worker's Prometheus gauges.

breakpoint.description: Arrival-rate stairs until a guard trips or the environment cap is reached.
breakpoint.name: breakpoint

capacity.description: Closed-model concurrency stairs, to read sustainable throughput per level.
capacity.name: capacity

load.description: Ramp to the expected busy-hour concurrency and hold; fails the release on SLO breach.
load.name: load

smoke.description: One pass of every journey, no think time. Proves the catalogue still matches the API.
smoke.name: smoke

soak.description: Modest constant load held long enough to surface leaks, drift and token expiry.
soak.name: soak

spike.description: A sudden 10x burst of arrivals and the recovery after it.
spike.name: spike

stress.description: Open-model arrivals stepped past busy-hour to see how latency degrades.
stress.name: stress
